courses.title: Gong Baths in Sheffield
courses.description: Evening gong baths at Trinity Methodist Church in Hillsborough, timed with new moons and the turn of the year, including a longer candlelit session at year's end. People lie and listen to the gongs with nothing to achieve, resting in the space between waking and sleep.

left_out: The page holds two dated sessions (New Moon gong bath 9 Dec 2026 and an extended candlelit gong bath 30 Dec 2026); they repeat through the year, so one undated item uses the page.
Winter Solstice Sound Bath (18 Dec 2026): still left out, the page claims the tea served strengthens immunity.
flags: Gong bath page says the gong 'can assist in understanding and processing trauma' and speaks of 'healing frequencies' and of rest in 'the healing process'; trauma and sound healing language, no claim to treat a medical condition. Kept under the new rule.
No price on the page (booking system only).
